named.about-page: Names the About page's root for whoever reads the markup; its look comes from the about-* classes inside it.
named.addon-install: Names the install rows among the settings rows; settings-row styles them.
named.addon-row: Names an installed plugin's row, which carries data-addon; settings-row styles it.
named.commands-page: Names the keybindings page's root; kb, beside it, styles it.
named.group-editor-place: Names the anchored place of the group editor; anchored styles it.
named.key-caps: KeyCaps' class when its caller gives none; its key-chord and key-cap children are styled.
named.menu-sub: Marks a menu that is a step inside another; the harness and menu.test.ts look for it.
named.pane-menu: Names the anchored place of a pane's menu; anchored styles it.
named.plugin-icon-wait: The empty box a plugin's picture fills while it loads; its size is set inline.
named.plugin-pick: Names a plugin's choice list, a palette; the harness finds it by this class.
named.status-label: A status item's label; the harness reads it by this class, and status-item styles it.
named.status-menu: Names the anchored place of a status item's menu; the harness finds the menu inside it.
named.status-meter: A status item's meter, an SVG sized by its attributes; status-meter-track and -fill are styled.
named.tab-menu: Names the anchored place of a tab's menu; the harness finds the menu inside it.
named.terminal-menu: Names the anchored place of the terminal's menu; anchored styles it.
